# Native-v21 — exposed 2.8.123 challenge regressions

The 21 unchanged packet files in provenance.json cover Boards 3/3 final clear,
Score 1260/1400 final clear, Fours 12/12 Challenge Complete/Continue and refused
Twos 0/10 entry and the later Fours 0/7 entry refusal. Originals remain under
the permanent validation root. These
are exposed regressions, not holdouts, new guest trials or executable receipts.

The profile differs from v20 only in profile_id and explicit
`board.challenge_final_clear: true`. Its new final-only alternative requires an
immutable initially incomplete requirement, the same actually read kind/target
and non-regressed count; Boards additionally advances exactly once. Independent
empty replay, all original scene/modal/exact-pile checks and 28 full 60×4 felt
bands are mandatory. The bottom seven bands use y+168, measured clear of the
new Perfect glow; all older proof geometry and thresholds remain unchanged.
This proves card effect only. Completion and a fresh next board retain their
separate positive observations, STOP/context and no-uncertain-retry guards.

The new exact Twos word, Fours 0/7 word and Fours title/Continue appearances are
separately recorded in ../../pyramid-objectives/native-123-provenance.json.
The additional Fours word sample comes from the unchanged 123 entry screenshot;
seven pixels exceed the old word sample's tolerance 9 (maximum difference 12).
The finite additional whole crop preserves that tolerance. No digit, glyph,
scene or matching threshold was raised; no additional rank was implemented.

Native adapter tests independently solve/replay the captured 57/60/64-action
deals. Their injected bindings and repeated original frames are offline inputs;
they establish no fresh live ACK, acquisition or final controller acceptance.
